subject: reasoning
question:
Arman starts from point A and drives 44 km towards south. He then takes a left turn, drives 42 km, turns left and drives 51 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 56 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 7 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Arman starts from point A and drives 44 km towards south.

He then takes a left turn, drives 42 km, turns left and drives 51 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 56 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 7 km and stops at point P. 

Drawing the diagram according to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45f24291d3cfbfb4091e7b9a57628da4c28ad30f3d9883e257e348ff4bd30387.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12cfd6e8bcd6102ca7ee19aa2dfb7391ee7359dff8d86599ea94dc1f70767af0.png] 

From the diagram, point P is located 14 km to the West of point A.

To reach point A again from point P, Arman should drive 14 km to the East.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1;**
